idea-plugin.name: Dynamic Wallpaper
idea-plugin.description:
Dynamic Wallpaper for IntelliJ IDEA

Play Wallpaper Engine-style animated wallpapers behind your IDE: video, GIF, image sequences and web wallpapers, with a layered transparent overlay window that composites at the OS level so the IDE itself is never repainted (no editor lag).

Features

  • Full-window animated wallpaper (file tree, editor, status bar)
  • Auto-discovers your local Wallpaper Engine workshop library (custom path supported)
  • Adjustable opacity, brightness and frame rate (5-60 fps)
  • Click-through overlay: all mouse and keyboard input still reaches the IDE
  • Right-side settings tool window; per-project or global
  • Pauses or drops to low fps when the window is hidden / you are typing

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 (build 262) or newer
  • For video wallpapers: ffmpeg available on PATH or in a standard install location (Windows). It is not bundled with this plugin. Without ffmpeg the plugin falls back to a pure-Java decoder (lower frame rate).
  • Windows recommended: the overlay uses a per-pixel translucent top-level window and native window styles (WS_EX_LAYERED | WS_EX_TRANSPARENT) for click-through.

Privacy

This plugin works entirely offline. It reads only local media files from the wallpaper directory you configure, stores its settings in the IDE configuration, and never sends data anywhere.

Third-party

Bundles JCodec (BSD-2-Clause) as a pure-Java fallback decoder. ffmpeg is invoked as an external process if present and is not redistributed.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • First public release.
  • Video wallpapers decoded by the system ffmpeg over a loopback socket (no per-frame decoding in Java), with automatic fallback to a pure-Java decoder.
  • Wallpaper is rendered in a separate per-pixel translucent window: IDEA is not repainted, so the editor stays responsive.
  • Fixed-cadence display clock removes stutter from uneven frame arrival.
  • Opacity / brightness / fps sliders in a right-side tool window.
